messages.subject: Workshop: Bayesian Inference and Hierarchical Modeling, Sept 27-28, Florida Atlantic University, Boca Raton FL  offered by Bob Dorazio
parts:
Dear all,

 Bob Dorazio is offering a workshop next month on "Bayesian Inference and Hierarchical Modeling" at Florida Atlantic University in Boca Raton. The attached 2-page pdf file includes a summary of the workshop (including dates, location, etc) and an outline of the topics to be covered and data sets to be analyzed.

 While not directly related to unmarked, it looks like some of the models and concepts should be of interest to users of unmarked. Please direct specific questions to Bob.

 regards,
andy
